en.name: iMyFinance
en.short_description: Private offline ledger for spending, budgets and subscriptions. No bank login.
en.subtitle: Offline budget and ledger
en.promotional_text: A first run is empty: every figure comes from what you enter. No bank connection, no account, and your ledger never leaves your phone. Supported by ads.
en.description:
MyFinance is a private ledger for money you enter yourself, kept in a database on your phone.

A FIRST RUN IS EMPTY
There is no demo balance waiting for you. The app opens with nothing in it, and every figure you see afterwards is calculated from rows you added.

TRANSACTIONS
Record income and spending with a description, an amount, a category, a date and an optional note. Tap any row to edit or delete it. The home screen totals income, expenses and the net for the current month, and your balance is the sum of your opening balance and every transaction on file.

ACCOUNT AND CURRENCY
Name your account, set the opening balance your total starts from, and choose the currency amounts are shown in. A first run picks your phone's currency. Changing it relabels amounts; it does not convert them.

BUDGETS
Set a monthly limit for a category. Each budget shows what you have spent against it so far this month with a progress bar, and marks the ones you have gone over.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Record recurring charges as weekly, monthly or yearly. MyFinance converts them to a common monthly figure so the total is comparable, and rolls each next charge date forward as it passes. The home screen lists what is due in the next thirty days.

EXPORT
Your transactions can be written to a CSV file and handed to the share sheet, so the data stays yours.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
MyFinance does not connect to a bank. There is no sync, no import and no account, your ledger is never uploaded, and the app works with no network connection at all. It also has no passcode or biometric lock, so anyone who can unlock your phone can open your ledger. There is nothing to buy. The interface is in English; numbers and dates follow your phone's region format.

ADS
MyFinance shows ads from Google AdMob: a banner above the tab bar and, now and then, a full-screen ad when you switch sections. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The app does not ask to track you across other companies' apps, and where consent is required (for example in the EEA and the UK) you are asked first and can change your choice later under More options > Privacy choices. Your ledger is never sent to Google or anyone else.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
MyFinance is a private ledger for money you enter yourself, kept in a database on your phone.

Intended audience:
Offline budget and ledger

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting
- Google AdMob (ads) — banner and interstitial ads, requested only after Google UMP consent where it is required. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. Non-tracking: the app shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt. Ledger data is never sent to AdMob.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.

differentiation:
1. WHAT IT DOES
MyFinance is a private ledger for money you enter yourself, kept in a database on your phone.
Screens it contains: Home (total balance, this month's income, expenses and net, upcoming subscription charges, recent transactions), Transactions (the full ledger, CSV export), Budgets (monthly limit per category with progress), Subscriptions (recurring charges with a monthly-equivalent total), plus add/edit sheets for transactions, budgets and subscriptions and an Account and currency sheet (account name, opening balance, currency).

2. INTENDED USER
People who want to track their own money by hand, without connecting a bank account or signing up anywhere. They enter income and spending, set a monthly budget per category, record subscriptions and export the ledger to CSV; the whole ledger stays in a database on the phone and the app works offline. It is not for users who want automatic bank import or a passcode-protected ledger — it has neither, and the store listing says so. The interface is in English.

Yes, infrastructure only: agl_i18n (shared translations for system text); agl_ads (Google AdMob banner and interstitial behind UMP consent); agl_observability is linked but never initialised, so this app sends no crash reports or analytics.
